audience: Researcher only; do not give this file or the source ledger to participants
status: Prepared task bank; not a ready comparative study or validated benchmark
selection: Ten reported-outcome candidates, excluding the low-confidence author-only barber workaround, plus two controls. The source-ledger classifications are unchanged.
purpose: Prepare a retrospective exercise about justified next checks. Authors already know the outcomes; this cannot validate unseen-case diagnostic accuracy or establish demand for a product.
outcomeLeakageLimits: Prompt facts are attributed summaries, not new live game observations.
Current source pages can contain later edits; a date alone does not prove the original text was unchanged.
Source URLs, titles, later releases and eventual solutions belong only in researcher materials.
Do not copy the ledger's context field into participant materials; several entries contain successful later versions or discovered causes.
D08 and D09 are explicitly retrospective reconstructions; D01's report already proposed a fix. They are not prospective pre-diagnosis snapshots.
notYetAvailable: Five willing target players and the pre-existing problem-discovery requirement
Case-specific outputs from the closest relevant competitors, with version, client context, equal inputs and setup cost
A verified full physical-missing-dependency, installation and working-result chain
A pre-registered condition assignment and scoring process reviewed independently before any responses
Unseen held-out incidents for any future claim of diagnostic accuracy

baseline.publicSupportAdvice: Available through each source ledger entry; reference material only, not a competitor's observed output or the participant's usual workflow

comparisonRules: Do not fabricate baseline or candidate outputs, participant responses, durations, scores or preferences.
Each participant sees a given case once. Rotate conditions across participants and balance case type and flavor. A repeated view after seeing advice is not an independent improvement.
Provide the same available facts to both conditions and count the effort to obtain additional facts.
Accept multiple warranted next checks and explicit uncertainty; the eventual fix is not the only correct initial action.
Separate next-check choice, unsupported confident attribution and time/confidence observations; do not collapse them into an invented success score.
Keep the existing advance rule: at least four of five improve next-check choices with no unsupported confident attribution. No part of this preparation satisfies it.
Preparation remains within the original two-hour cap starting 2026-10-11T22:14:00+02:00. Participant sessions are capped at twenty minutes.
